attachments_owner_check.name: attachments_owner_check
attachments_owner_check.value: "attachments"."quote_request_id" IS NOT NULL OR "attachments"."order_id" IS NOT NULL

customers_nit_dv_check.name: customers_nit_dv_check
customers_nit_dv_check.value: "customers"."nit_check_digit" IS NULL OR ("customers"."nit_check_digit" BETWEEN 0 AND 9 AND "customers"."document_type" = 'NIT')

cuts_measured_check.name: cuts_measured_check
cuts_measured_check.value: "cuts"."method" = 'FREEHAND' OR ("cuts"."cut_length_mm" IS NOT NULL AND "cuts"."cut_width_mm" IS NOT NULL AND "cuts"."cut_area_mm2" = "cuts"."cut_length_mm" * "cuts"."cut_width_mm")

cuts_measured_no_freehand_check.name: cuts_measured_no_freehand_check
cuts_measured_no_freehand_check.value: "cuts"."method" = 'FREEHAND' OR ("cuts"."freehand_size_id" IS NULL AND "cuts"."reconciled_count_id" IS NULL)

movements_sign_check.name: movements_sign_check
movements_sign_check.value: ("inventory_movements"."type" IN ('INITIAL_IN','PURCHASE_IN','REMNANT_IN') AND "inventory_movements"."area_mm2" > 0) OR ("inventory_movements"."type" IN ('CUT_OUT','DISCARD') AND "inventory_movements"."area_mm2" < 0) OR "inventory_movements"."type" IN ('FREEHAND_ADJUST','COUNT_ADJUST','MANUAL_ADJUST')
